expectation.note: 1997-09-04T09:00 EDT is 13:00Z, exactly UNTIL, and is therefore included.

normative_evidence.quote: If the value specified by UNTIL is synchronized with the specified recurrence, this DATE or DATE-TIME becomes the last instance of the recurrence.

rationale: Inclusivity is stated normatively and is still implemented as exclusive by some engines; it is cheap to test and decisive.
title: UNTIL is inclusive when it names an instance exactly
